answer: Named-witness spiral registration. Each new identity must be attested by three existing operators who each performed a distinct physical act: a hardware-signed gesture recorded at a unique ledge location (GPS-tagged, time-bound). Attestations form a spiral: each witness must themselves have been attested through a different grove of prior witnesses, preventing closed cliques. Faking requires three real operators at three real locations per identity, each risking their own standing. Cost per sybil identity: three colluding operators plus three distinct physical site visits.
